[FACT] User is interested in Tirana dishes.  
[FACT] User is not a fan of strong alcohol.  
[EVENT] User plans to try Ayran with their next Tirana meal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The most popular beverage to pair with Tirana dishes is raki, which is a clear, strong alcoholic drink often served as an aperitif or digestif.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Several non-alcoholic beverages that pair well with Tirana dishes include Ayran, Boza, Turkish tea, Lemonade, and Orange juice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] If looking for a spicy Tirana dish to pair with Ayran, Tave Kosi is recommended. Tave Kosi is a lamb and yogurt casserole cooked with garlic, butter, and flavored with mint.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The tanginess of Ayran can help to cool down the spiciness of Tave Kosi and balance out the dish's bold flavors.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] There are many restaurants in Tirana that serve Tave Kosi and Ayran, including Oda, Serendipity, Mullixhiu, Era Restaurant, and Sofra e Ariut.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Oda is a popular restaurant in the heart of Tirana that specializes in traditional Albanian cuisine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Serendipity is a cozy restaurant that offers a mix of European and Albanian dishes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mullixhiu is a fine dining restaurant that offers a modern take on Albanian cuisine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Era Restaurant offers traditional Albanian dishes, with outdoor seating and a cozy atmosphere.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Sofra e Ariut specializes in traditional Albanian cuisine, located in a historic building in the city center.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It's a good idea to do some research and read online reviews before choosing a restaurant.  
[EVENT] User checked out the recommended restaurants and found Mullixhiu interesting.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mullixhiu is known for offering a modern take on traditional Albanian cuisine, and in addition to Tave Kosi, they may serve Fërgesë, Byrek, Qofte, Baklava, and Flija.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Fërgesë is made with peppers, tomatoes, onions, and cheese, usually served with bread.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Byrek is a savory pastry filled with cheese, meat, or vegetables.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Qofte are seasoned meatballs typically made with lamb or beef, often served with a tomato sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Baklava
